notes.title: HOTFIX: 12/30/2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We strive to make the gameplay more enjoyable and are gradually fixing bugs. If you encounter a bug, you can post it in our discord server and we will try to fix it as soon as possible! 
https://discord.gg/RWWSZxJbgZ


If you have difficulties with the new version of the game, you can still continue to play on the previous version. To do so, you need to change the branch for the beta version in Steam to "old_stable".

notes.title: PATCH NOTES: 12/28/2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's a list of the new features we've added in this small update.
[list]
[*] Added vertical synchronization
[*] Added new music
[*] Added free construction mode - all zone restrictions will be removed for non-major tasks (aka sandbox). Yes, this feature does not impose any additional restrictions and you can change it at any time!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021025/5879c302682a327cc3d64c0e2e37c644e2623d76.jpg[/img]

If you have difficulties with the new version of the game, you can still continue to play on the previous version. To do so, you need to change the branch for the beta version in Steam to "old_stable".

notes.title: HOTFIX: 12/26/2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

In this small hotfix, the display of the green zone has been improved and some hints have been added to make the game more comfortable.

If you have difficulties with the new version of the game, you can still continue to play on the previous version. To do so, you need to change the branch for the beta version in Steam to "old_stable".
